_comment: OMN-16184: desired state for the omninode realm's declarative User Profile (upConfig). Before this file the realm's user-profile config existed ONLY live, hand-mutated, with no representation in source -- so the attribute permissions that decide which fields render on user-facing forms, and which attributes persist at all, were unreviewable and undiffable. Applied via PUT /admin/realms/{realm}/users/profile. Validated by .github/workflows/user-profile-contract.yml. The apply path is NOT yet wired (OMN-16195) -- this is validated desired state, not an applied artifact. See https://github.com/OmniNode-ai/knowledge-base-internal/blob/main/reference/keycloak-user-profile.md. OMN-18165: firstName and lastName are NOT required. The omniweb signup form labels both optional and does not submit them, and the form is the product contract -- a required-for-role-user declaration here makes Keycloak's VERIFY_PROFILE required action fire on every such account's first login, which is what blocked the C5 sign-on walk. Both remain declared, user-viewable and user-editable, so a user who wants to supply a name still can; they are simply not a precondition of signing in. email stays required.
